### [`blog-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/blog-menu.ts)

- `trimExcerpt` _function_: Cut on a word boundary, never mid-word, and only when there is something to cut.
- `toMenuPost` _function_: One post as a row of the panel, and of the most-read lists (`lib/blog/most-read.ts`). The opener's teaser is longer than a row's (`LEAD_EXCERPT_CHARS`), which is the only difference between the two.
- `getBlogMenu` _function_: Builds the header's blog panel for a locale: the article categories by post count, the five most recently touched articles with trimmed excerpts and covers, and how many articles there are.
- `getPostSearchIndex` _function_: Every post of a locale for the site search: the articles in the guides panel's order, most recently touched first, then the news, newest first.
- Types: `BlogMenuCategory`, `BlogMenuPost`, `BlogMenu`, `PostSearchEntry`

### [`featured-parks-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/featured-parks-menu.ts)

- `getFeaturedParksMenu` _function_: The parks menu's photo cards for a locale, memoised per process: everything it reads is fixed for the deployment, and the layout asks on every page. Callers share the array and must not mutate it.
- Types: `FeaturedParkCard`

### [`geo-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/geo-menu.ts)

- `getGeoMenu` _function_: Continents with their countries, sorted by park count.
- Types: `GeoMenuCountry`, `GeoMenuContinent`

### [`glossary-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/glossary-menu.ts)

- `getGlossaryMenu` _function_: Builds the glossary section of the header's "more" panel: each category with its translated label, `#category` link and term count, sorted by label.
- Types: `GlossaryMenuCategory`, `GlossaryMenu`

### [`history-navigation.ts`](../../lib/navigation/history-navigation.ts)

- `onHistoryNavigation` _function_: Subscribe to programmatic history navigations. Returns the unsubscribe function.
- `suppressScrollToTopFor` _function_: Ask the next commit of `pathname` not to scroll to the top — the companion of `<Link scroll={false}>` for this app's own handler. Call it from the link's `onClick`.
- `consumeScrollSuppression` _function_: Read and clear the flag. Returns whether THIS pathname was the one asking.
- Types: `HistoryNavigationType`, `HistoryNavigationListener`

### [`more-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/more-menu.ts)

- `menuPhoto` _function_: A catalog photo as a header band draws it: the pre-cut 16:9 crop where there is one (it was cut around the focal point already), else the original and where its subject is.
- `getMoreMenu` _function_: Builds the header's "more" band for a locale: the glossary, guide and best-time hubs with their photos and chapters, the Fancast card and a tile per live trip region.
- Types: `MoreMenuPhoto`, `MoreMenuChapter`, `MoreMenuHub`, `MoreMenuRegion`, `MoreMenu`

### [`news-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/news-menu.ts)

- `getNewsMenu` _function_: The header's news panel for a locale, memoised per process: the manifest is fixed for the deployment, and the layout and the homepage hero both ask for it.
- Types: `NewsMenuItem`, `NewsMenu`

### [`planner-menu.ts`](../../lib/navigation/planner-menu.ts)

- `pickPlannerParks` _function_: The parks the band offers, from the locale's counted parks (most opened first) and a curated list to top up with: an event is never offered (`isEventPark`), nor a counted park that had no published hours ahead when the build read the geo …
- `plannerParks` _function_: A locale's parks: its counted ones, topped up from the homepage's `FEATURED_PARK_SLUGS`.
- `getPlannerMenu` _function_: The planner band for a locale. The parks and the regions' words and photos are modules of this repo, memoised per process like `getFeaturedParksMenu`, since the layout asks on every page; the park counts are the API's list of regions, a …
- `PLANNER_MENU_PARKS` _const_: How many parks the band offers: two columns of three.
- Types: `PlannerMenuRegion`, `PlannerMenuPark`, `PlannerMenu`

### [`post-search.ts`](../../lib/navigation/post-search.ts)

- `matchStrength` _function_: How well `word` sits in `text`, both folded: 1 where it starts a word ("dis" in "Disneyland"), half inside one from four letters on, so German compounds answer ("karte" in "Jahreskarte") while a short fragment does not drag in every word …
- `queryWords` _function_: The words of a query, folded; `isPostQuery` and the search split it the same way.
- `isPostQuery` _function_: Whether `query` is long enough to search for, rather than to keep showing the newest posts.
- `searchPosts` _function_: The posts that match every word of `query`, best first, and how many there are in all. A word matches in the title, category, tags, linked parks or teaser, accents and case folded, weighted by `FIELD_WEIGHTS` and `matchStrength`.
- `searchPostsBySection` _function_: `searchPosts` split into the articles and the news, each best first and cut to `limit`, with how many match in all: the search palette and `/search` list the two as groups of their own.
- `BLOG_MENU_SEARCH_LIMIT` _const_: Rows the guides panel shows for a query: its two columns of four, as tall as the newest posts.
- Types: `PostSearchSection`
